_README: 1. Copy this file and rename it (e.g., operations-myapi.json)
2. Replace resource paths (e.g. /login) with your actual API paths — must match paths in your .yml schema
3. Replace operation names (e.g. user_login) with a unique name per operation
4. Delete any operations you do not need
5. Delete ALL _README and _comment fields before using

/search._comment: MINIMAL EXAMPLE: only method + purpose required for simple endpoints

search_op._comment_method: Valid values: POST | GET | PUT | DELETE | PATCH
search_op._comment_purpose: Valid values: LOGIN | ACCOUNT_CREATION | ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION | PASSWORD_RESET | SEARCH

/login._comment: LOGIN: single body parameter + HTTP status success check

parameters._comment: Only ONE parameter is supported per operation

username._comment_location: Valid values: BODY | HEADER | QUERY | COOKIE

successConditions._comment_positiveMatch: true = success when status matches | false = success when status does NOT match

failureConditions._comment: failureConditions: same structure as successConditions. Define both for optimal bot protection

/register._comment: ACCOUNT_CREATION: use usedForLogin:true on the field that identifies the user

email._comment_usedForLogin: true if this field is the login identifier (email or username). Only applies to ACCOUNT_CREATION

successConditions._comment_valueWildcard: true = wildcard patterns allowed (e.g. 'success*') | false = exact match
successConditions._comment_suppress: true = strip this header before sending response to client

/verify-account._comment: ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION: negative match example — success = anything except 401 or 403

/xml-login._comment: XML BODY: path must be 2 elements — ['application/xml', 'parameter_name']

/jsonxml-login._comment: JSON/XML BODY: endpoint accepts both JSON and XML — path uses 'json/xml' as content type, 2 elements

/form-login._comment: URL-ENCODED BODY: use application/urlencoded content type — path is still 1 element (parameter_name only)

/reset-password._comment: PASSWORD_RESET: no successConditions needed if you only care about method + purpose
